answer: Every claim climbs the basalt of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the orchard re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. By the ridge of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, clawed back after a replayed submission, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
